content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make an over the hill cake, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Apply dark grey crumb coat (20 minutes)
Step 2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees (10 minutes)
Step 3. Prepare the cake board with foil (15 minutes)
Step 4. Dye fondant pitch black (15 minutes)
Step 5. Grease and flour the hill-shaped baking pans (5 minutes)
Step 6. Mix black cocoa powder into the batter (10 minutes)
Step 7. Level the cooled cake layers (10 minutes)
Step 8. Bake the cakes (45 minutes)
Step 9. Whisk together charcoal buttercream frosting (15 minutes)
Step 10. Purchase all dry ingredients and decorations (1 hour)
Step 11. Design the "tombstone" message (30 minutes)
Step 12. Let the cakes cool on a wire rack (1 hour)
Step 13. Wash the mixing bowls and beaters (10 minutes)
Step 14. Roll out black fondant for the hill covering (20 minutes)
Step 15. Sift the confectioners' sugar (5 minutes)
Step 16. Stack the cake layers with filling (25 minutes)
Step 17. Sculpt a "rocky" texture into the fondant (30 minutes)
Step 18. Cut out gum paste letters for the name (40 minutes)
Step 19. Chill the assembled cake in the fridge (2 hours)
Step 20. Mix the cake batter (15 minutes)
Step 21. Brew strong coffee to darken the chocolate flavor (5 minutes)
Step 22. Place the final "Happy 50th" topper (5 minutes)
Step 23. Add coffee to the liquid ingredients (2 minutes)
Step 24. Unpack the decorative plastic skeletons (10 minutes)
Step 25. Drape the fondant over the cake (15 minutes)
Step 26. Order a custom "Rest in Peace" cake topper (3 days)
Step 27. Print out a reference image of a grassy hill (5 minutes)
Step 28. Pipe green "moss" around the base (30 minutes)
Step 29. Knead softening agent into old fondant (10 minutes)
Step 30. Dye a small batch of frosting grass-green (10 minutes)
Step 31. Soften the butter at room temperature (4 hours)
Step 32. Prepare the chocolate ganache filling (20 minutes)
Step 33. Chill the filling to a spreadable consistency (1 hour)
Step 34. Sanitize the plastic graveyard fence (5 minutes)
Step 35. Smooth the final layer of buttercream (25 minutes)
Step 36. Pipe decorative grass borders (20 minutes)
Step 37. Sketch the cake layout on paper (15 minutes)
Step 38. Roll out white gum paste (10 minutes)
Step 39. Arrange the plastic skeletons around the cake (10 minutes)
Step 40. Assemble the miniature graveyard fence (15 minutes)
